Name: Bonaventure
Summary: Franciscan theologian and minister general of the order, known as the Seraphic Doctor.
Contribution: He systematised Franciscan theology, wrote the classic Life of Saint Francis that shaped Franciscan memory, defended the mendicant orders, and joined rigorous theology to mystical ascent to God.
KeyWorks: The Soul's Journey into God; Life of Saint Francis
Testimony: He sought God through contemplation as well as study, teaching that the soul journeys into God through prayer, humility and love.
